# glmmlpack260

GLMs and machine learning material for BST 260

Installation: ensure that you have devtools and remotes packages
installed, then

    devtools::install_github("vjcitn/glmmlpack260")

# Package index

## All functions

- [`clotting`](https://github.com/vjcitn/glmmlpack260/reference/clotting.md)
  : a data.frame with data from table 8.4 of McCullagh P and Nelder JA,
  Generalized Linear Models (1989)
- [`mnist`](https://github.com/vjcitn/glmmlpack260/reference/mnist.md) :
  a list with integer matrices and vectors representing handwritten
  digits as obtained by dslabs::read_mnist
